trial.title: Fetoscopic Repair of Isolated Fetal Spina Bifida

endpoints.measure: Ability to perform fetoscopic spina bifida repair
endpoints.time_frame: From time of surgery until delivery (up to 21 weeks)
endpoints.description: Successful complete closure of the defect fetoscopically and reversal of hindbrain herniation on ultrasound and MRI prior to delivery

endpoints.measure: Maternal obstetric outcome as evidenced by preterm premature rupture of membranes
endpoints.time_frame: From time of surgery until 37 weeks of gestation (up to 18 weeks)
endpoints.description: Preterm premature rupture of membranes occuring any time from surgery until 37 weeks of gestation

endpoints.measure: Maternal obstetric outcome as evidenced by preterm labor leading to delivery at less than 34 weeks of gestation
endpoints.time_frame: From time of surgery until 34 weeks of gestation (up to 15 weeks)
endpoints.description: Preterm labor occuring at any time from surgery leading to delivery before 34 weeks of gestation

endpoints.measure: Maternal obstetric outcome as evidenced by gestational age at delivery
endpoints.time_frame: From time of surgery until delivery (up to 21 weeks)
endpoints.description: Gestational age of delivery regardless of indication

endpoints.measure: Maternal obstetric outcome as evidenced by the ability to delivery vaginally
endpoints.time_frame: From time of surgery until delivery (up to 21 weeks)
endpoints.description: Mode of delivery - either vaginal or cesarean section

endpoints.measure: Adverse fetal or neonatal outcome as evidenced by fetal or neonatal death
endpoints.time_frame: From the time of surgery until 28 days of life (up 25 weeks)
endpoints.description: Composite of fetal or neonatal death

endpoints.measure: Adverse early childhood outcome as evidenced by need for a cerebrospinal fluid shunt
endpoints.time_frame: From the time of birth until 12 months of life
endpoints.description: Need for a cerebrospinal fluid shunt within the first year of life

endpoints.measure: Neurodevelopmental outcome as evaluated by the Bayley Scales of Infant Development II
endpoints.description: Score of the Mental Developmental Index of the Bayley Scales of Infant Development II at 30 months of age. The score ranges from 50 (minimum) to 150 (maximum). A score of \<70 indicates severe developmental delay; 70-84 indicates moderate delay; \>85 indicates no delay.

endpoints.measure: Early childhood motor function on physical examination
endpoints.description: Difference between the anatomic upper border of the lesion level and motor function based on the physical examination at 30 months of age. A positive score of 2 indicates a functional level 2 vertebrae higher than lesion level. A score of -2 indicates a function level 2 vertebrae lower than the lesion level.
